Install TagAlign Tool for Revit 2023
====================================

1. Extract zip → run Install.bat
2. FULLY close Revit, then reopen
3. Check: Add-Ins tab → External Tools → "TagAlign Align Selected Tags"

Keyboard shortcut:
1. Type KS
2. Search: TagAlign
3. Assign TA to "TagAlign Align Selected Tags"

If KS is empty: External Tools must show TagAlign first (add-in loaded).
If DLL error 0x80131515: Unblock RevitTagAlign.dll (Install.bat does this).

If "No work plane set":
  Use a Floor Plan / Section / Elevation view (not a Sheet),
  or Architecture → Work Plane → Set, then run TagAlign again.
  Latest build auto-sets a temporary work plane when possible.
